title: Up to the castle
steps: The castle's great door stands open at last, the last seal broken.
We did it! We worked together and finally got it open!

It has been quite a day, from your very first step to the gate to when you picked up the wand and made that long walk in one instruction! We learned that a program is a list of instructions; your wizard is an object, the one the code calls `wizard`, and its actions are methods; a comment is a note for a person, and a move's argument says how many steps to take.

The password *ambrel* was a string, words in quotes kept exactly as written, and saying it with `say` opened the gate. Then `pick_up` picked up the wand, and with it you cast a spell, *zelim*, which broke the two seals!
Thank you so much for your help! Casting my first spell with the wand was definitely my favorite part.

You are welcome, but that wand is only lent! Our teacher, Ilda, waits inside, and the wand bank is a counter in the castle run by the Parent-Teacher Association that lends every new pupil a school wand for the year; then you can give my spare back.
You walk into the castle together, out of the dusk and into its great dark hall: your first year at Arvelia begins.
